issues.problem: Nの上で was described as suru-noun only, but an example uses 話し合いの上で (話し合い is not a suru-noun), so the explain and pattern contradicted the example.
issues.action: Changed 'suru-noun' to 'action noun' in explain and pattern; added 話し合いの上で to the explain list.

issues.problem: Mistake 'レベルに基づいて、問題の難しさが変わります' was borderline rather than plainly wrong; natives do use レベルに基づいて in similar sentences.
issues.action: Replaced with 季節に基づいて (bad) / 季節に応じて (good)、メニューが変わります, where に基づいて is clearly wrong.
